Original unmodified photograph of [[Counter Assault (Japanese)]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)]], published by [[Decipher]] in Japanese.<ref name="photo">[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/star-wars-ccg-japanese-premiere/imagegallery/29544 Japanese Premiere collector gallery], PSA; [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/202709162/wvmRKBmCNUqxBOLV2wZX6g.jpg original photographed face].</ref>

The original PSA holder and printed card edges are retained. Card artwork and text are reproduced for identification and comparison.
